TWO WOMEN NOMINATED 


TO YMCA METRO BOARD 


Two women, a university professor and a free-lance broad- 
caster, are among this year's nominees to the Metropolitan Board 
of the Montreal YMCA. 

They are Mrs. Muriel Armstrong of Stir George Williams 
Universtty's Department of Economies and Madame Jeanne Sauve, a 
well-known expert in publie affairs. 

Elections to this policy-making body will be held on the 
evening of Monday, October 6, 1969, immediately after the 
Montreal YMCA's 117th annual meeting, which is scheduled to run 
from 6:00 - 8:15 p.m. 

Other new nominees as dtrectors of the Greater Montreal 
Assoctatton are: 

C. A. Duff, Vice-President and Managing Director, Henry 
Birks & Sons Ltd. 

L. Y. Fortier, a partner in the legal firm of Ogilvy, 
Cope, Porteous, Hansard, Marler, Montgomery and Renault.
